## Execution checkpoint — IN PROGRESS, not roadmap completion

**Six of twenty original issues have local full-scope acceptance and independent review evidence.** The twenty issues, eighty acceptance criteria, forty-one native dependency links and five milestones remain the delivery contract. GitHub issues remain open; this comment does not close issues or milestones, assign people, change dates, merge, deploy, or reduce scope.

| Original issue | Locally accepted result |
|---|---|
| #2 | Evidence, claim and temporal contracts. |
| #3 | Qualified CC0 financial-original source route and acquisition boundary. |
| #5 | Actual native Brain evidence persistence and relationship semantics, including the authorized final continuation4/4. |
| #6 | Rights-preserved economics investigation pack, counterevidence and provenance. |
| #8 | Real-investigation visual comparison; Felipe selected guided questions first, retaining relationship and timeline lenses. Prototype acceptance is not production #9 acceptance. |
| #11 | Separate attention, activity, adoption and capability semantics. |

### Published accepted checkpoint

Draft [PR #22](https://github.com/namastex888/trending-research/pull/22) has the actually pushed and API-verified head **`f429a573ddc98ce8aef50520c2e420d1ea883f19`**. [Complete current original and separate quality SHIP reports, plus the actual clean 43-test/evaluator/lint evidence](https://github.com/namastex888/trending-research/pull/22#issuecomment-6092121217) are published in full, with the stored comment body read back exactly. [Original #8 all-four-criteria checkpoint](https://github.com/namastex888/trending-research/issues/8#issuecomment-6092218101) records the actual keyboard/focus and responsive visual observations. The clean43-test run concerns the committed accepted checkpoint; it does not qualify uncommitted read-model or DSH work. No CI checks were reported for this reviewed head; **CI acceptance is not claimed**.

### Current true blockers and admitted work

- **#7 read model:** full native snapshot persistence previously failed; the original receipt and clocks are retained, the large Scene root remains unattempted, and the native failure cause is **UNKNOWN**. The second authorized prospective diagnostic review cycle ended **FIX-FIRST** in both complete independent reviews, with three distinct HIGH gaps: whole successful-response completeness before follow-on reads; primary-evidence preservation before alarm/cleanup; and LF-complete, bounded native-frame admission. Both reviewers settled and were released only after full report acceptance. Felipe explicitly authorized **one additional prospective cycle, cap3 total**, retaining both earlier exhausted cycles. The original engineer received full-method approval for complete DATA-only preparation. Source application, safe changed-path smoke and native causal activation remain separate gates; no fourth cycle is automatic.
- **#4 DSH integration:** the stock prospective2/2 exhaustion and one actual failed zero-model startup are retained, not reset. The owner-authorized modified-native architecture is **DESIGN ONLY**. Its first full original review found one HIGH gap in capturing native Cordis cleanup outcomes before disposer errors are swallowed; the separate quality report found zero HIGH, which does not waive that finding. Both full reports settled. A bounded two-document design repair1ofB2 is authorized after a full pre-access method ACK, followed by two fresh whole-scope independent reviews. No source/SDK implementation, further startup, runtime or model call is authorized by this design repair.
- **#9 and #13** await actual #7 acceptance; #9 has no invented #4 predecessor. Other work remains behind the existing native dependencies. Draft artifacts, static reviews, local tests and task readiness are not substitutes for each issue’s actual consumer acceptance.

The parent remains the **orchestrator**, routing code authorship and source review to native workers. Product model calls remain **0**; the isolated validation cap remains **USD20 total** (DSH12/Brain8). Coding, storage and all-in costs are **UNKNOWN**, not reported as zero. Paid-use admission remains held until actual native identity, cancellation, physical-egress reservation, tariff/output/retry/queue/background/ancillary and raw-usage guards qualify. Brain continuation4/4 is not reset into a fifth attempt.
